messages.content: 獲取蘋果公司、谷歌有限責任公司和微軟公司在紐約證券交易所的最新收盤價格和交易量。

function.name: get_stock_data
function.description: Retrieve the most recent trading day's closing price and volume for a specified stock. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

symbol.description: The stock symbol of the company.

data_points.description: The type of data you want to retrieve for the stock. This can include closing price, opening price, volume, etc.

message.reasoning: The user wants the most recent trading day's closing price and volume for Apple, Google LLC, and Microsoft on the NYSE. The user explicitly requests the data points "closing price" and "volume". The function signature requires the data_points argument to be either "price" or an array of strings. The user wants both price and volume, so we need to pass an array ["price", "volume"] for each symbol. We have three symbols: AAPL, GOOG, MSFT. We can call the function once with all three symbols? The function signature only accepts one symbol at a time. So we need to call the function three times, one for each symbol. The user wants the data for all three companies. We can do separate calls for each symbol. The user didn't specify the exchange, but the function doesn't accept an exchange parameter. The function will return the most recent trading day's closing price and volume for the specified symbol. We'll call the function for each symbol.
